name: @w6w-apps/mighty-networks
description: Manage members, spaces, posts, comments, events, invites and tags in a Mighty Networks community via the Admin API.

w6w.longDescription:
Mighty Networks is a community platform for creators and brands — spaces, courses, events, posts and paid plans under one branded Network — and this app runs it through the Mighty Networks Admin API.

It covers the operational core of a Network: members (list, look up by id or email, create, update, add to or remove from spaces, tag), spaces, posts and comments, events with RSVPs, invitations, tags, plans and course content. A connection is one Network: the Network ID or subdomain is stored with the Admin API token, so no action asks for it again.

Good for onboarding automation — create a member or send an invite and drop them into the right spaces and tags — for publishing posts and scheduling events from another system, and for reading a Network's membership, plans and course structure into a CRM or reporting tool. The Admin API needs the Scale, Growth or Mighty Pro plan.
